# TemporalFeaturePropagation

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
The mechanism by which spike-based features from earlier layers propagate through time to influence later layers in a spiking point cloud model. Critical for capturing dynamic 3D structure and motion cues, bridging temporal dynamics of SNNs with spatial topology of point clouds in TCC pipelines.
